questions.question:
Choose the correct sentence.

I have lived in London for five years. Last year, I moved there.
options: I have lived in London for five years. Last year, I moved there.
I have been living in London for five years. Last year, I moved there.
I lived in London for five years. Last year, I moved there.
I am living in London for five years. Last year, I moved there.
questions.answer: I have lived in London for five years. Last year, I moved there.

questions.question: Which sentence correctly uses the past perfect tense?
options: When I arrived, the meeting had already started.
When I arrived, the meeting started.
When I arrived, the meeting was starting.
When I arrived, the meeting has already started.
questions.answer: When I arrived, the meeting had already started.

questions.question:
Select the correct option to complete the sentence.

If I _____ more time, I would have finished the report.
Which modal verb is used to give a strong warning or prohibition?

Complete the sentence with the correct form of the verb.

After he _____ from university, he started his own business.
Which sentence correctly compares two things using comparatives?
options: My new apartment is more bigger than my old one.
My new apartment is more spacious than my old one.
My new apartment is much big as my old one.
My new apartment is more big than my old one.
questions.answer: My new apartment is more spacious than my old one.

questions.question:

If it _____ tomorrow, we won't go to the beach.

Select the correct option to complete the sentence.

He didn't go to work because he _____ ill.
Which sentence uses the gerund correctly?

Choose the best word to complete the sentence.

The film was so _____ that I didn't want to leave the cinema.
